certificate.title: CERTIFICATE
certificate.subtitle: Learning Path
certificate.privacyHint: Your name is only in the PDF. It is not saved.

sectors.foundationDesc: Start here if you are new. You can use a computer? Then this is for you.
sectors.workshopDesc: Try things out. Use tools. Build things.
sectors.academyDesc: Go deeper into computer science. Like a university course, but easy to follow.
sectors.societyDesc: How AI affects people, laws, and different groups.
sectors.miscDesc: Here are demos that do not fit any other learning path. You can simply try them.

seedPath1.title: Start Here
seedPath1.description: This path shows you the basics of your subject. What is it? Why is it important?
seedPath1.learningPromise: After this path you can say what the subject is.
seedPath1.targetAudience: For beginners. You need no prior knowledge.

steps.introDesc: Learn the main idea of the subject.

seedPath2.title: Your Subject in Daily Life
seedPath2.description: See where your subject is around you. For example in search or tips.
seedPath2.learningPromise: After this path you can find your subject in daily tools.

steps.introDesc: Find daily things that use your subject.

computerBasics.title: Understanding Computers
computerBasics.description: Four basics: the command line. The development environment. Version control. And connections between programs.
computerBasics.learningPromise: After this learning path you can open a terminal. You know what a repository is. And you understand how programs talk to each other.

steps.terminalDesc: A terminal is a window for commands. You type a command. The computer runs it.
steps.devEnvironmentDesc: This is where you write programs. You learn: this is how you set everything up.
steps.versioningDesc: A repository remembers every change. So you cannot break anything.
steps.networkDesc: How a request travels through the internet. And how two programs connect.

agentsBasics.title: Working with AI Agents
agentsBasics.description: You write an instruction in plain language. An AI agent does the work. This path shows how that works.
agentsBasics.learningPromise: After this learning path you give an AI agent good instructions. You know what belongs in its context. And you understand how an agent uses tools.
agentsBasics.targetAudience: Anyone who wants to work with AI agents

steps.naturalLanguageDesc: You write what you want. The AI writes the code. That has benefits. And limits.
steps.contextDesc: An AI can only read a little text at once. You learn what belongs in there.
steps.interfacesDesc: How a program talks to an AI model. And how an agent uses tools.
steps.harnessEngineering: Harness Engineering (clear rules instead of hope)
steps.harnessEngineeringDesc: Build the setup around the agent. With inspection stations, a sandbox, and a memory.

quality.title: Software Quality and Testing
quality.description: You learn: What is a test? What do machines check? And what must never go into a repository?
quality.learningPromise: You read a test. You understand what it checks. You see when green means nothing. And you know what must stay secret.

steps.agentTests: Understanding tests when the AI writes them
steps.agentTestsDesc: Green does not mean everything is right. You learn to read a test.
steps.qualityGatesDesc: You learn the 5 questions behind red. And you learn the allowed way past it.
steps.codeReview: Checking Without Knowing How to Program
steps.codeReviewDesc: You learn the shape of a diff. And you learn 3 testable questions.
steps.secretsSecurity: Secrets: What Must Never Go Into a Repository
steps.secretsSecurityDesc: You learn what a secret is. And what you do when one gets out.

knowledgeConcepts.title: Second Brain & Digital Twins
knowledgeConcepts.description: Write down your knowledge and connect it. Understand digital copies of real things.
knowledgeConcepts.learningPromise: You build a second brain. That is a store for your knowledge. And you understand digital twins.
knowledgeConcepts.targetAudience: Everyone. You need no prior knowledge.

steps.secondBrain: Second Brain: Your Memory Outside Your Head
steps.secondBrainDesc: You write your knowledge down. You connect the notes. This way your knowledge helps you think.
steps.digitalTwinsDesc: A digital twin is a computer copy of a real thing. You learn: it can do this. And it cannot do that.

underTheHood.title: Under the Hood
underTheHood.description: A real project built with AI agents, seen from the inside. With rules, checks, and the places where mistakes are expected.
underTheHood.learningPromise: You will see in a real project: which rules does a machine check? Which rules are only text? And why do the tests run in the build?
underTheHood.targetAudience: Anyone who wants to work with AI agents

steps.tour: The Tour: How This Project Is Built with Agents
steps.tourDesc: 10 stops through a real project. Every stop names a file. You can open it yourself.
